record.field: Learn how to set up WhatsApp sessions, Email sessions, auto-send toggles, and configure your module for seamless communication. Covers WhatsApp QR code setup, Email session (Gmail/Outlook) setup, auto-send configuration, payment receipt settings, and POS notification settings.

Learn how to create broadcast campaigns, import contacts, schedule messages, and reach multiple customers at once. Covers creating broadcast campaigns, importing contacts from CSV/Excel, Lead Finder integration, scheduling broadcasts, and tracking delivery status.
